item.title: Ceuta: entre las solicitudes de asilo y los nuevos intentos de cruce
item.description: Semanas después del cruce masivo desde Marruecos a finales de julio, miles de personas siguen en Ceuta a la espera de una respuesta a sus solicitudes de asilo. Mientras sobreviven en asentamientos improvisados junto a la playa, Marruecos refuerza los controles fronterizos y España alerta de un fuerte aumento de los cruces hacia Ceuta y Melilla. ¿Qué está pasando ahora en el enclave español y cuál es la respuesta de las autoridades? Lo analizamos en Migrantes de France 24. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Spain builds tent cities for the thousands stuck in Ceuta
item.description: Spain is building four temporary reception sites with 1,500 places as an estimated 5,000 migrants remain in Ceuta. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: In Ceuta, migrants stranded at Europe’s gates await their fate
item.description: Weeks after some 70,000 migrants tried to cross from Morocco into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta, the ones who chose to stay have settled on El Trampolin beach. They hail from various countries, speak different languages and crossed many borders to get to this strip of sand. Europe seems very close, and yet so far. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Singapore: Independent rights experts urge immediate end to ‘unlawful use’ of death penalty
item.description: Independent UN Human Rights Council-appointed experts on Tuesday condemned the execution of at least 16 people in Singapore for drug-related offences this year and urged the country to end its “continued and unlawful use of capital punishment.” Fuente: UN News.

item.title: Create judge training pathway to tackle Hong Kong courtroom delays: think tank
item.description: Hong Kong should establish a full-time training pathway for top law graduates to become judges, helping to expand the local judicial talent pool and ease courtroom delays, a think tank founded by Executive Council member Ronny Tong Ka-wah has proposed. POD Research Institute founder Tong also said on Tuesday that reducing waiting times for a court date would ensure the rule of law was upheld and safeguard human rights. The think tank noted that the vacancy rate among judges and judicial officers... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: ‘Come fetch your people’: 300 anti-migrants protesters call out to SADC leaders
item.description: South Africa hosted a gathering of leaders from the southern African regional bloc amid xenophobic violence and anti-migrant protests. As the continent’s wealthiest country, South Africa has long attracted migrants, but it faces an unemployment rate of over 30 percent and deep-seated inequalities. Pretoria has called for a continent-wide conference on the issue of migration. Details by Eunice Masson, FRANCE 24 correspondent in Cape Town. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Indian student leader ends hunger strike after 16 days
item.description: Devendra Nath Mahto was part of a larger protest which began weeks ago, demanding exam reforms in Jharkhand state. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: “A las puertas de Europa”: miles de migrantes esperan en Ceuta conocer su destino
item.description: Ceuta, el enclave español situado en el norte de África, recibió a finales de julio a miles de migrantes. Algunos se instalaron en la playa El Trampolín, donde personas de distintas nacionalidades e idiomas sobreviven en condiciones precarias. Europa parece estar muy cerca, pero su futuro sigue siendo incierto y el temor a ser expulsados es permanente. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: France 24

item.title: Anti-migrants protesters gather outside SADC Summit
item.description: Anti-migrant protesters in South Africa gather outside a meeting of regional leaders, demanding that they "fetch their people". Frustration continues to fester on all sides as Pretoria tries to repair fractured relationships with its neighbours while placating the powerful anti-migrant movement. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: Georja CALVIN-SMITH
